As Pepsico (PEP) Valuation Declined, Shareholder Cubist Systematic Strategies Has Trimmed by $3.74 Million Its Position; Apple Computer (AAPL) Holding Maintained by Beach Investment Management Llc
May 26, 2018 - By Ellis Scott
Beach Investment Management Llc increased its stake in Apple Computer (AAPL) by 30.21% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Beach Investment Management Llc bought 2,480 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 10,690 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.81 million, up from 8,210 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Beach Investment Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Computer for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $926.90B market cap company. The stock increased 0.23% or $0.43 during the last trading session, reaching $188.58. About 15.45 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Cubist Systematic Strategies Llc decreased its stake in Pepsico Inc (PEP) by 79.83% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cubist Systematic Strategies Llc sold 31,414 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.24% with the market. The institutional investor held 7,937 shares of the consumer non-durables company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $952,000, down from 39,351 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cubist Systematic Strategies Llc who had been investing in Pepsico Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $142.23 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.13% or $0.13 during the last trading session, reaching $100.31. About 4.38M shares traded. PepsiCo, Inc. (NYSE:PEP) has declined 3.75% since May 26, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 15.30% the S&P500.
Cubist Systematic Strategies Llc, which manages about $1.88B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Intra Cellular Therapies Inc (NASDAQ:ITCI) by 47,643 shares to 53,932 shares, valued at $781,000 in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Hub Group Inc (NASDAQ:HUBG) by 11,235 shares in the quarter, for a total of 14,935 shares, and has risen its stake in Hancock Hldg Co (NASDAQ:HBHC).
